reason: The hypothesis directly restates the exact intervention (Y and Hf co-doping) and the primary outcome (improved hot corrosion resistance and thermal stability) already demonstrated in P2 and P6 for the same alloy system. The extension to mechanical properties (strength, ductility, creep) is a minor addition that follows the generic suggestion in P9 and P11 that alloying can improve properties, without a new mechanistic link or integration of disparate sources.
